items.condition: Submitted structure identity, atom mapping, charge or multiplicity is missing or inconsistent with the public record.
A potential is reported without converged state evidence or any stationary-point/frequency validation.

A numerical result is supplied for a failed calculation without completed-state evidence, or source/paper values are presented as newly computed results.
